entities.name: PharmaCore
entities.description: Legacy system currently processing all pharmacy claims outside the main Clearview platform
entities.overview: PharmaCore is the existing pharmacy claims processing system that handles approximately 50K claims per quarter. It operates independently from Clearview's main claims platform and is scheduled for replacement as part of the 2026 roadmap migration.
entities.details: PharmaCore processes all of Clearview's pharmacy claims volume (~50K per quarter) but operates entirely outside the modern claims platform. The system is considered legacy and is targeted for replacement in the 2026 roadmap. Dana Okafor has the most knowledge about this system's current operations. The migration planning will involve decisions about NCPDP transaction standards, formulary integration, PBM integration strategy, pharmacy network pricing, and clinical drug review integration.

entities.reasoning: PharmaCore is clearly described as a named system that processes pharmacy claims, fitting the definition of a system that implements domain-specific business logic

entities.name: Pharmacy Claims Migration (2026)
entities.description: Planned migration of pharmacy claims processing from PharmaCore to the main Clearview platform
entities.overview: A planned initiative for 2026 to bring pharmacy claims processing onto Clearview's main claims platform. This migration will require integrating NCPDP standards, formulary systems, PBM relationships, pharmacy networks, and clinical review processes.
entities.details: The 2026 roadmap includes migrating pharmacy claims from the legacy PharmaCore system to the main Clearview platform. Key integration points include: NCPDP transaction standards (pharmacy equivalent of EDI 837), formulary integration for covered drug lists per benefit plan, PBM integration decisions (continue external or bring in-house), pharmacy network and pricing integration (MAC, AWP, WAC pricing models), and clinical drug review/DUR integration. Priya Anand is designated as the engineering contact for migration planning.

relationships.reasoning: Document identifies Priya as the engineering contact for migration planning
Migration will replace PharmaCore with platform integration

entities.reasoning: This represents a business process with defined steps and stakeholders, involving the migration from one system to another
